blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) has no tax clearance to prove that lawyer Manases “Mans” Carpio, Vice President Sara Z. Duterte’s husband, had actually transferred his alleged shares in Cale88 Foods Corp. Former Rep. Robert Ace Barbers, House impeachment adviser and spokesperson, pointed this out in a press briefing on Wednesday, explaining that sales of company shares, like sales of land, are taxed. He said the BIR issued a negative certification showing it had no electronic Certificate Authorizing Registration (eCAR) for the reported sale of Carpio’s shares to Pikimong Pikimong Philippines Corp.
